lines.en: : With Maya, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是和 Maya 恢复正常。

lines.en: scene endofchristmalloween29
: Honestly, all that “will they/won’t they” stuff about getting back together had gotten {i}so{/i} annoying over the last couple of years that even I was like, “oh my god, just do it already.”
lines.zh: : 老实说，过去这几年关于你们会不会复合的那些「到底会不会」的戏码{i}实在{/i}太烦人了，连我都想说：「我的天，你们赶紧做吧。」

lines.en: scene endofchristmalloween30
if amifingered == True:
: Not enough to stop getting in the way whenever I could, though. My Daddy’s at his best when he’s pumping his little girl full of hot father juice.
lines.zh: : 不过这并不妨碍我一有机会就从中作梗。我爸爸最棒的时候，就是往他的小姑娘体内灌满热腾腾的爸爸汁的时候。

lines.en: else:
: Not enough to stop getting in the way whenever I could, though. My Daddy’s at his best when he’s forced to go long periods of time without sexual relief.
lines.zh: : 不过这并不妨碍我一有机会就从中作梗。我爸爸最棒的时候，就是被迫长时间得不到性发泄的时候。

lines.en: : Just like his poor daughter that he condemned to a life of infinite masturbation while she does his laundry!
lines.zh: : 就像他那个可怜的女儿，被他判了无期——一辈子只能无限自慰，还得给他洗衣服！

lines.en: : You knew?...
lines.zh: : 你知道？……

lines.en: : About us?
lines.zh: : 关于我们？

lines.en: scene endofchristmalloween31
: Do you think there’s anything I {i}don’t{/i} know about you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得关于你还有什么我{i}不{/i}知道的？

lines.en: : Because that’s specifically how I’m able to take such good care of you, Dad.
lines.zh: : 因为正是靠着这一点，我才能把你照顾得这么好，爸爸。

lines.en: : Everything I do is to make {i}you{/i} happy. And you should never question any decision I make because I am always right. Okay?
lines.zh: : 我做的每一件事都是为了让{i}你{/i}开心。你永远不该质疑我的任何决定，因为我永远是对的。好吗？

lines.en: : No, Ami...you’re {i}not{/i} always right. You weren’t right when you pushed Niki out of the house. You weren’t right when you decided to stab me.
lines.zh: : 不，Ami……你{i}并不{/i}总是对的。你把 Niki 赶出家门的时候就不对。你决定捅我的时候也不对。

lines.en: scene endofchristmalloween32
: That-
scene endofchristmalloween33
: {i}That{/i} was an accident...And I’m still really sorry for it.
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}是个意外……而且我到现在都真的很抱歉。

lines.en: : I get scared sometimes. I’m still just a teenager, you know. But I try to be strong and, even when you hide things from me for as long as you hid Maya, I put on a brave face for {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我有时候也会害怕。我终究还只是个十几岁的孩子，你知道的。但我在努力坚强，就算你像隐瞒 Maya 那样瞒了我那么久，我还是会为{i}你{/i}装出一副勇敢的样子。

lines.en: : Are you hiding anything from me, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你有什么事瞒着我吗，Ami？

lines.en: scene endofchristmalloween34
: You really think I’d do that, Daddy?...
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得我会那么做吗，爸爸？……

lines.en: scene endofchristmalloween35
: I’d need to have a pretty good reason for it if I did, huh?
lines.zh: : 如果我真那么做了，那得有个相当充分的理由才行，对吧？

lines.en: : Did you and Ayane actually have a talk earlier?
lines.zh: : 你和 Ayane 之前真的谈过话吗？

lines.en: : I don’t remember. We have talks all the time. Which one are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 我不记得了。我们经常聊天啊。你说的是哪一次？

lines.en: : The one about what’s happened to this place.
lines.zh: : 关于这个地方发生了什么的那一次。

lines.en: : I don’t remember. We have talks all the time. Which one are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 我不记得了。我们经常聊天啊。你说的是哪一次？

lines.en: : Dad?
lines.zh: : 爸爸？

lines.en: : You’re faking that, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是在装的对吧？

lines.en: : Faking what? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 装什么？你什么意思？

lines.en: : {i}I don’t remember. We have talks all the time.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不记得了。我们经常聊天啊。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m just trying to figure out what you’re talking about here. What’s so hard to understand about that?
lines.zh: : 我只是想搞清楚你到底在说什么。这有什么难理解的？

lines.en: : Ami...if you {i}know{/i} more than you’re letting on...I need you to tell me.
lines.zh: : Ami……如果你{i}知道{/i}的比你说出来的多……我需要你告诉我。

lines.en: : Well, again, I have no idea what you’re talking about. But let me just say this-
lines.zh: : 嗯，再说一次，我完全不知道你在说什么。不过我就说一句——

lines.en: : If there was a car speeding down the road with a driver passed out behind the wheel and {i}you{/i} were right there in its way-
lines.zh: : 如果有一辆车在公路上飞驰，司机却昏倒在方向盘后，而{i}你{/i}正好就挡在它前面——

lines.en: : I’d become my mother for you.
lines.zh: : 我会为了你变成我妈妈那样。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : I’ll become her {i}without{/i} that, though. So you can finally know how it feels to be loved again.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}就算没有{/i}那种情况，我也会变成她那样。好让你终于能再次体会到被爱是什么感觉。

lines.en: : Now, ask yourself — how could a girl that caring {i}ever{/i} want to hurt you?
lines.zh: : 现在，问问你自己——一个这么体贴的女孩，怎么{i}可能{/i}想伤害你呢？

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Dad.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，爸爸。

lines.en: : Do yourself a favor and check on Ayane, will you? She’s probably going through it right now.
lines.zh: : 帮自己个忙，去看看 Ayane 吧，好吗？她现在大概正难受着呢。

lines.en: scene black
: ...Yeah.
: Yeah, I’ll...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我会……

lines.en: : I’ll go check on her...
lines.zh: : 我会去看看她的……
